title: Relay service log line
description: One JSON object per line on stderr. See logging-standard.md. Lines that do not start with '{' (panics, third-party output) are allowed and are not validated.

op.description: Dotted operation name, for example schedule.create or job.fire.

duration_ms.description: 0 for a line that marks a point in time.

error.description: Empty string when status is ok. Names the failure; never carries a body or credential.

trace_id.description: Empty string outside any user action, such as startup or a background tick.
